content.title: Things to do in Johor Bahru (JB) 🇲🇾 Beyond Shopping | Family-Friendly Activities Near Singapore
content.text: We discovered a hidden blue lake in Johor Bahru (JB), just 30 minutes from Woodlands Checkpoint, Singapore. This peaceful, family-friendly nature walk is perfect for Muslim families looking for a quiet escape away from the busy city. In this video, we share a relaxing day exploring one of JB’s lesser-known nature spots, with an easy walk suitable for beginners and kids. The lake is truly blue in real life, the atmosphere is calm, and it’s a beautiful reminder of how slowing down and reconnecting with nature can feel deeply grounding. We’re a Muslim family from Singapore who recently made hijrah to Malaysia. On this channel, we share Muslim family travel, slow living, and everyday life in Johor, along with tips and inspiration for those considering hijrah to Malaysia. We also end the day with a glimpse of a hotel in Johor Bahru with a great dinner buffet, perfect for families after a day outdoors. If you enjoy peaceful travel, halal-friendly experiences, and Muslim family life in Malaysia, don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more. --- 📌 WHAT YOU’LL FIND IN THIS VIDEO • Hidden blue lake in Johor Bahru • Family-friendly nature walk near Singapore • Muslim family travel in Malaysia • Life in Johor after hijrah • Relaxed weekend ideas in JB 00:00 Intro 01:00 Where to park 04:39 View from the top 07:46 Easy vs difficult route 09:42 Hotel dinner buffet Blue Lake Johor.
